Worst Experience at Fab Hotel

I stayed at a Fab Hotel and had a really bad experience. I had booked a premium room for triple occupancy. At the time of booking, I was told the room will have one king-size bed and one single bed, and I even paid extra for it. But when I reached the hotel, the receptionist said there's no premium room here and if I want extra bedding, I’ll have to pay again. That was really disappointing.

When I entered the room, there were empty beer cans in the dustbin, the pillows were dirty, and the cushions were torn. I’ve never seen such poor maintenance in any hotel before.

If you don’t want to ruin your stay, better avoid this place.
